reason: LoongPort is a DeepSeek Harness integration that configures verified or manually supplied OpenAI-compatible providers and can explicitly write the corresponding DSH settings and credentials.

summaries.zh: LoongPort 为 DeepSeek Harness 配置已验证或手动提供的 OpenAI 兼容服务端点及相应凭据。
summaries.en: LoongPort configures verified or manually supplied OpenAI-compatible service endpoints and credentials for DeepSeek Harness.

capabilities: configures OpenAI-compatible provider endpoints for DeepSeek Harness
writes selected DSH settings and credential files when explicitly requested
uses an API key supplied through the LOONGPORT_API_KEY environment variable
